overrides.release-notes: notes are assembled from conventional commit subjects by tools/release.mjs, one audience, into CHANGELOG.md; no per-audience trailers and no strict checker here, `node tools/release.mjs patch --dry` is the check
overrides.release-tree: dropped: no store and no generated native project; tools/release.mjs cuts a release in any clean tree, a second tree has nothing to collide on
overrides.build-numbers: dropped: there is no build number, only the version in package.json, and tools/release.mjs bumps it
overrides.pushing: dropped: pushing is the user's call every time (see Commits and Finishing a release); the canon pushes on commit
